purpose: Recommended free source stack for player role and bowling-style enrichment.

recommendedPrimarySource.name: cricketdata::player_meta
recommendedPrimarySource.reason: Best free practical structured source for batting style, bowling style, and playing role, already designed around Cricsheet/Cricinfo identity linkage.

supportingSources.name: Cricsheet Register
supportingSources.reason: Best free identity bridge via Cricsheet identifier plus external ids such as Cricinfo; required to join free metadata reliably.

supportingSources.name: IPL official site
supportingSources.reason: Useful for squad validation and coarse specialization labels, but not strong enough as the sole structured source of batting/bowling style.

supportingSources.name: Wikidata
supportingSources.reason: Open fallback for some bowling-style / role gaps, but coverage is incomplete and inconsistent.

supportingSources.name: Direct Cricinfo public pages
supportingSources.reason: Rich metadata source, but better treated as a fragile fallback or manual check than as the default pipeline.

avoidAsPrimary.name: Paid subscription APIs
avoidAsPrimary.reason: User cannot rely on subscriptions right now, so they should not be the default source path.

avoidAsPrimary.name: Cricbuzz scraping / unofficial wrappers
avoidAsPrimary.reason: Fragile and not backed by a public official developer API in the current research pass.

avoidAsPrimary.name: IPL official site scraping as sole source
avoidAsPrimary.reason: Useful as a supplement, but not reliable enough as the only structured source for batting/bowling style.

freeJoinStrategy.step2: Join to full Cricsheet Register people.csv via identifier/cricsheet_id
freeJoinStrategy.step3: Use Cricsheet Register key_cricinfo to bridge into cricketdata::player_meta or other Cricinfo-derived metadata
freeJoinStrategy.step4: Use names.csv and manual overrides only for fallback resolution

notes: The current local player_registry.csv is too slim by itself; full Cricsheet Register people.csv is needed for the strongest free ID-based join.
cricketdata::player_meta is the best free practical metadata source for V1, even though it is a packaged derivative rather than an official API.
